shortDefinition: An application pattern that retrieves relevant source evidence and supplies it as context for generation.
Retrieval that enforces the requesting identity's source permissions before content reaches the model.
A system that uses a model to choose actions or tools dynamically within explicit permissions and stopping rules.
A curated, representative set of inputs and expected quality labels used for repeatable evaluation.
A control that pauses a consequential automated action until an authorized person reviews its context and arguments.
An open protocol for exposing tools, resources, and prompts to compatible AI applications through standard interfaces.
A concise description of the affected user, failing workflow, measurable impact, desired outcome, and constraints.
